name: Stop The Tsunami!
desc:
🌊 A GIANT TSUNAMI IS COMING. Build the defences that keep the town dry!

Dig sand, pile it into walls, carve trenches and pack them hard. Then press START ROUND and watch the wave hit. Every wave you hold back pays coins, so upgrade and build bigger for the next one.

🏖️ HOLD THE BEACH
Clear a stage and the sea pulls back. The beach gets wider and the waves get bigger. Can you save the town all the way to the end?

🚜 FROM SPADE TO EXCAVATOR
Start with a toy spade, then work up to shovels, a bulldozer, a skid steer, excavators and a dump truck.

🪨 LATE-GAME MATERIALS
On the full beach, haul gravel, drop boulders, sculpt clay and pour concrete for walls that can take a monster wave.

👥 PLAY WITH FRIENDS
Share one coin wallet and every machine. One digs, one drives, one patches the wall mid-wave!

⭐ Easy, Medium and Hard modes
🎁 Daily Spin and daily rewards
🏖️ Join the Beach Club group for a free Rewind!

llm.loop: dig sand and build walls/trenches -> start the round and watch the tsunami hit -> earn coins for every wave held -> upgrade from spade to excavators -> bigger beach and waves
llm.objectives: hold back every wave to save the town
llm.progression: tools/vehicles, materials (gravel, clay, concrete), stages, difficulty modes
llm.instructions: dig, pile, pack walls, press START ROUND
unique: sand-castle tsunami defense with heavy machinery
llm.thumbnails: giant wave crashing toward sand walls, first-person excavator cockpit
llm.complexity_notes: deformable sand terrain, water/wave sim, drivable machines
